acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the recipient to choose from dispatcher-confirmed alternative slots.

must_not: Do not promise arrival at a precise minute or say the lamp has been delivered.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Dispatch has offered 2028-02-01 15:00–18:00 or 2028-02-02 10:00–13:00, both at no charge. Which should I ask them to book?

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-001: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. 32 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
